# Wiki

The wiki of a vault stores readable pages as place nodes: a page, its sections in order and the notes on them. Pages link to each other by id, for example [the item types](knowledge-items.md#types-and-bodies).

W58 and its `wiki_pages` table are gone since C0 2.2. Pages export as Markdown, one file per page or a zip per vault.

## How It Works

Every page is folded from the place log, like every other node.
